long_biography.plain_text:
Working inside the Gandel family's retail and property businesses gave Ian Jeffrey Gandel experience in shopping-centre construction, leasing and company governance. He later brought that background to the Priceline chain and a serviced-office business, where he served as chief executive.

Mining became a separate investment chapter from 1994. Through controlled investment vehicles, Gandel accumulated major positions in listed resources companies and financed exploration in his own right. At Australian Strategic Materials, he has chaired development of an integrated rare-earths and critical-materials business. He remains ASM's non-executive chair and a non-executive director at Alkane Resources.
